query.description: Expiration date in `YYYY-MM-DD`, taken from Option Expirations. Other formats (e.g. `2026-9-30`, `2026/09/30`) are rejected.
OCC root. If omitted, only **standard** contracts are returned. To list corporate-action-adjusted contracts (e.g. `GOOG1`), pass the `rootSymbol` from Option Expirations.
Number of contracts to exercise. Whole number, minimum `1`, up to `availableQty`.
Quote asset. Only `USDC` (default) is supported; other values return `497104`.
Client ID. Format `^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]{32,36}$`. Generated by the server when omitted.

Number of contracts. Must be a whole number, minimum `1`.
Limit price (premium) per share, minimum `0.01`, must be a multiple of `tickSize`. For a put `SELL` order it cannot exceed the strike price (`497438`).
